'''Li'lith''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was stationed on the Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where she served the Empire as a vendor, working out of a tent near the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], selling items such as [[Targeting beacon|targeting devices]] and [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[sparkle powder]]. Li'lith had pale colored skin, brown hair and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. During her time as a vendor, she wore a gray Imperial uniform and used a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Li'lith first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she acted as a social items vendor on Korriban, the starting world for players of the [[Sith Warrior]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]] classes. Her position was also marked on a map along with other vendors in [[Prima]]'s [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide|guide]] to the ''Old Republic.
